programme.title: S05 E04
programme.desc: Jana and Imara run into familiar faces as they track Hartington. Selina competes in the taekwondo fight of her life and in doing so makes an unlikely ally. Jeffries laments the end of his career.

programme.title: S05 E05
programme.desc: TJ’s good intentions land him in hot water with Selina. The Humans group target the Kafe. A face from the past returns to take action that will change everything.

programme.title: S05 E06
programme.desc: It’s dark moon day, Katrina’s Grandad has made the Kafe a wolfblood free zone and Emilia’s fate rests on Hannah. Imara and Jana make a breakthrough in proving the conspiracy, but who can they trust?

programme.title: S05 E07
programme.desc: Jana and the pack ask Emilia to tread carefully now that they suspect government officials are conspiring with Hartington to chip and de-wolf wolfbloods. But Emilia has no intention of backing down and makes a public display in the city, resulting in a devastating choice for wolfbloods everywhere.

programme.title: S05 E08
programme.desc: Unable to help Selina’s parents, Jana resolves to find a way to help the other trapped wolfbloods, starting with The Genesis Project. Matei returns to the den to seek Jana’s help in convincing Emilia that her vision of Blydissiad is false. But Madoc has his own secret agenda.

programme.title: S05 E09
programme.desc: Jana is forced to realise that she can’t save everyone and must make a decision about her future. TJ and Matei track Emilia but discover that Madoc is now pack leader. They join the journey to Blydissiad but are in for a shock. Katrina refuses to accept Robyn’s actions.

programme.title: S05 E10
programme.desc: Jana fulfils her promise to come after Hartington. Dr Whitewood discovers the amazing truth about Project Genesis. TJ finds himself with a huge responsibility.

programme.title: S01 E01
programme.desc: When ZOEY and KIKI, two irrepressible girls from another galaxy land in Lightning Point, their dreams of surfing the waves of Earth’s oceans have finally come true!

programme.title: S01 E02
programme.desc: With their space ship obliterated and no other way of getting home, KIKI and ZOEY settle into the teenage world of Lightning Point at AMBER’s house.

programme.title: S01 E03
programme.desc: To blend in, ZOEY and KIKI start attending AMBER’s school – and find it nothing like school on LUMINA.

programme.title: S01 E04
programme.desc: When KIKI is moved to tears by AMBER’s singing, AMBER makes an important discovery – Luminans can only experience emotions on Earth.

programme.title: S01 E05
programme.desc: Quadrupeds fascinate KIKI and when she finds out that LUCA’s horse BANDIT has been skittish and dangerous to ride ever since they arrived, she feels terrible.

programme.title: S01 E06
programme.desc: LUCA and KIKI have been growing closer and AMBER is sick of being stuck in the middle! Finally, LUCA asks KIKI out on a date – and KIKI can’t wait.

programme.title: S01 E07
programme.desc: When ZOEY escapes the washing up to recharge her energy, AMBER and KIKI think nothing of it – until a big burst of lightning strikes their house. Rushing upstairs, they find ZOEY gone.

programme.title: S01 E08
programme.desc: ZOEY is finding BRANDON a challenging surfing adversary. He’s even started to compliment her on her moves.

programme.title: S01 E09
programme.desc: As ZOEY, KIKI and AMBER head out to the Benedict cane field, owned by BRANDON and LUCA’s family, ZOEY is excited.

programme.title: S01 E10
programme.desc: With LUCA and BRANDON dangerously close to their secret, KIKI feels that they have no choice but to stick close to them, to find out what they really know.

programme.title: S01 E11
programme.desc: ZOEY is sick of waiting and decides to take charge of finding a way home. Back at the cane field, ZOEY and AMBER test out the energy field one more time.

programme.title: S01 E12
programme.desc: When a storm is forecast to hit Lightning Point, ZOEY and KIKI know it’s time – they can send a signal through the lightning, via the energy field and back to Lumina.

programme.title: S01 E13
programme.desc: KIKI and ZOEY are anxious – with no reply from Lumina and LUCA knowing who they are, they’re no longer safe in Lightning Point.

programme.title: S01 E14
programme.desc: Many weeks after the boat was discovered in the cane field, no clues have been found and no further message from Lumina has come.

programme.title: S01 E15
programme.desc: AMBER is totally excited when her crush, JOSH has noticed her at school. She’s doubly excited when he asks her to help organise a Hawaiian fundraiser party for his basketball team.

programme.title: S01 E16
programme.desc: When OLIVIA rings AMBER about a surprise waiting at home for her, AMBER would never have guessed that the surprise was her Dad KEITH!

programme.title: S01 E17
programme.desc: LUCA is finally letting his guard down with KIKI again – and soon they’re back to their old friendship.

programme.title: S01 E18
programme.desc: The gang decide not to let BRANDON know about the toy lighthouse until they know more about it.

programme.title: S01 E19
programme.desc: BRANDON and ZOEY are closer than ever and are keen to spend as much time together as possible.

programme.title: S01 E20
programme.desc: KIKI and ZOEY are relieved to find out that half-Luminan BRANDON can’t use the card properly. The only way they can be sure they are out of danger though, is to destroy the card.

programme.title: S01 E21
programme.desc: With BRANDON fully charged, ZOEY can’t help but feel that BRANDON needs to know the truth about her. How can she be his girlfriend and keep lying to him?

programme.title: S01 E22
programme.desc: BRANDON is furious with everyone – and especially ZOEY – for lying to him. How could they keep a secret like this from him?

programme.title: S01 E23
programme.desc: The day of the Lightning Point Junior Girls Surfing Competition is here and everyone from Lightning Point is ready to compete. Except ZOEY.

programme.title: S01 E11 Sink or Swim
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 H2O : Just add Water, Season 1
programme.desc: Emma trains Byron for the swimming competition. At first they get along well and even share a kiss, but too soon Emma becomes the training dragon. Byron fires Emma but when he wins the comp he tries to hug her and she recoils.

programme.title: S01 E12 The Siren Effect
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 H2O : Just add Water, Season 1
programme.desc: The full moon strikes Cleo, turning her into a magical siren, attracting all the young males in the vicinity. Cleo enjoys the attention and is encouraged to sing for them, but a concert at the Juice Bar as the moon sets reveals her truly awful voice.

programme.title: S01 E13 Shipwrecked
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 H2O : Just add Water, Season 1
programme.desc: When the mysterious old woman’s boat and home is declared unseaworthy Emma invites her over to stay. Zane gets trapped on the sinking boat and Emma tries to save him.

programme.title: S01 E14 Surprise!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 H2O : Just add Water, Season 1
programme.desc: Cleo’s dad plans an embarrassing surprise party for her birthday so she escapes to Mako Island. Zane and Lewis almost spot her there on their expedition to catch the sea monster.

programme.title: S01 E15 The Big Chill
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 H2O : Just add Water, Season 1
programme.desc: Emma is put in charge of managing the juice bar. Miriam decides to cause trouble and cuts the power to the cool room, then is unwittingly frozen by Emma who uses her powers to fix the freezer. Will the girls be able to thaw Miriam out?

programme.title: S01 E16 Lovesick
programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 H2O : Just add Water, Season 1
programme.desc: A dolphin at Sea World will only eat from Cleo’s hand and when she has to sneak out to feed him, everyone thinks she has a boyfriend.

programme.title: S01 E24
programme.desc: BRANDON is so excited by his alien energy that he starts to recharge – way too often.

programme.title: S01 E25
programme.desc: BRANDON is finally ready to learn who he truly is. As ZOEY speaks to him, she becomes more and more convinced that BRANDON has secrets locked inside his memories.

programme.title: S01 E26
programme.desc: AMBER, ZOEY and KIKI take a last surf of Lightning Point’s waves. ZOEY and KIKI will miss this place – and AMBER – when they leave for Lumina tonight with BRANDON.

programme.title: S01 E01
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: To help their friend Cleo get hired (as a volunteer) at the Dolphin City Oceanic Centre, Rikki, Emma and Lewis take her out free-diving off Mako Island, to see underwater wildlife in person! But when their motorboat’s engine fails, they have to spend the night on the island: that night, when Rikki, Emma and Cleo are exploring the island, they fall into a mysterious cave.

programme.title: S01 E02
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Little Elliot gets his big sister Emma to enter the Grand Sand Sculpture contest with him. Meanwhile Cleo’s day starts badly at the Oceanic Center: Mr. Lambert puts her in charge of the new intern - Miriam, the Mayor’s daughter and high school pest! Miriam lives up to her reputation, and submits Cleo to a series of capricious outbursts.

programme.title: S01 E03
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: During a scientific experiment conducted by Lewis out at sea, the three mermaids find a wooden statue of a white mermaid on the seafloor! Lewis discovers it’s the figurehead of a famous pirate galleon, the White Mermaid, which sank at sea without a trace! Rikki and Emma are thrilled, while Cleo is preoccupied by something else.

programme.title: S01 E05
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Amanda abuses magic for her guitar playing and forces Kuru to accept a rune, forbidden magic transfer. Kuru reports on her progress to Omar, who orders him to change and address the council.

programme.title: S01 E06
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Alex still puts her teenager life above royal duty. Yet Manjipoor cheerfully awaits her return. Vashan and his servant Diva only pretend approval. Kuru visits Omar, who reassures him time should help.

programme.title: S01 E07
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: After Kuru reports Alex still doesn't concentrate on her magic training, Omar invites her. The elders decide to hold a banquet, Vashan prepares a snake venom-drink. Alex misses the appointment because she prefers to play with her band in a talent competition they only make trough her magic abuse.

programme.title: S01 E08
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Amanda convinces Alex to visit Manjopoor, and shop at the oriental market. Anala drags along suspicious JB too. They end up in the magic forest and are mistaken for circus people by humble locals. Trying to help their son Johan, who was transformed into a mouse by Vashan for poaching.

programme.title: S01 E09
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Despite Kuru's warning that love and magic don't mix, Alex tricks him to tell her a spell to prove if Marcus, who asked her on a band date, loves her. It turns her into a frog, which can only be undone by a kiss from a true lover.

programme.title: S02 E05 Hocus Pocus
programme.sub-title: S02 : E05 H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Cleo notes that Don seems to be down since her mother left. Later, Lewis finds an old book on mermaids and tests out a potion recipe on the girls, supposed to grant wishes. Cleo instantly thinks it could help get Don and her Mum back together. They make the potion and it doesn’t seem to work.

programme.title: S02 E06 Pressure Cooker
programme.sub-title: S02 : E06 H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Life isn’t the same at Cleo’s house since her mother left. When it appears that Don has a girlfriend - Cleo and Kim are horrified, thinking this means a step-mother. Meanwhile, Charlotte is making more moves on Lewis, making Cleo increasingly jealous. Don organises a dinner and Cleo is shocked to find her Dad’s new partner is Charlotte’s mother!

programme.title: S02 E07 In Hot Water
programme.sub-title: S02 : E07 H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Cleo has been getting into some trouble with her boss Mrs Geddes at work and when Ronnie the dolphin splashes her, Cleo laughs and is fired. At the same time, Lewis finds himself in desperate need of a job after his laptop dies and, unbeknownst to him, he is offered Cleo’s old job. Upset, the girls use their mermaid powers to make the job unbearable for Lewis.

programme.title: S02 E08 Wrong Side of the Tracks
programme.sub-title: S02 : E08 H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Riding their dirt bikes, Zane and Nate stop in a trailer park to look at a classic Harley. Nate steals a badge from the bike and Zane is busted by the owner - little does he know it’s Rikki’s dad. Later, embarrassed by her family’s financial situation, Rikki hides where she really lives from Zane. Rikki has to overcome her shame about her background and introduce her dad to Zane.

programme.title: S02 E09 Riding for a Fall
programme.sub-title: S02 : E09 H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Elliot is going to horse riding lessons and Emma is cornered into taking him. Emma meets Ash - a handsome horse riding instructor. They clash immediately. Emma tries to prove herself and goes too far. When a horse falls ill Emma must use her powers to fix the situation. Meanwhile, Lewis asks Cleo to accompany him to a formal awards night in a limo.

programme.title: S01 E04
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Emma’s in a dilemma: handsome Byron has invited her to his birthday party on his uncle’s yacht. Her girlfriends tell her it’s no place for someone who transforms into a mermaid at the slightest drop of water. But Emma willfully goes along. Afraid she’ll do something silly, her girlfriends and Lewis join the party.

programme.title: S01 E05
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: A grand holiday resort on Mako Island? Its idyllic slopes covered with concrete and the volcanic lake inside the mountain, where the mermaids first transformed, converted into a swimming pool? Only Zane’s father could have dreamed up such a development. But Emma, Cleo and Rikki aren’t going to let this happen!

programme.title: S01 E06
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Emma loses her mermaid nature and her powers after touching some mysterious blue seaweed. Remembering what it’s like being “normal” - she used to be a passionate swimmer - she rejoins the synchronized swimming team, which is preparing a show for the Summer Solstice Festival.

programme.title: S01 E07
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: More and more plastic bags are polluting Dolphin City Bay, and the turtles mistake the bags for sea-sponges and suffocate on them. Our three mermaids, alerted by their friend Teddy the turtle, tackle the problem. After some unsuccessful attempts, they and Lewis decide to use stronger methods to stir up public opinion.

programme.title: S01 E08
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a violent storm, Dolphin City looks like a new Bermuda Triangle: boats mysteriously break down or sink in the bay. At the sight of hordes of journalists, the girls investigate, with Lewis’ help. They find out that a lightning bolt from the storm has activated mysterious crystals whose magnetic field disrupts navigation equipment.

programme.title: S01 E09
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: When Emma, Cleo and Rikki find out two superstars – Brad Patinson and Scarlett Belladonna - are shooting a film in Dolphin City, directed by the famous Martin Fabiola, they try anything to get on the set. Luckily Zane has been hired by the production! Only Rikki prefers to approach the stars in her own way – underwater of course!

programme.title: S01 E10
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Murray and Burke are inconsolable: their pal Danny the octopus has disappeared! By chance, Cleo finds out that he’s in fact been captured by the Oceanic Center, who are conducting scientific research. Murray puts pressure on the mermaids to get Danny out of there and bring him back to the sea. But Danny doesn’t want to go home.

programme.title: S01 E11
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Why has a whale calf run aground on an isolated beach near Dolphin City? And what’s causing the girls’ migraines? Does it have anything to do with the dolphin twins’ bizarre sickness? During their investigations the mermaids come across a strange fishing boat using illegal technology: an extremely low-frequency military radar device.

programme.title: S01 E12
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Burke the hammerhead shark has broken a tooth. To sooth the pain, he has to come up for air at the surface regularly: but in so doing, he involuntarily shows his fin. Before long a panic wave runs through the citizens of Dolphin City, who think they’ve got a dangerous shark on their hands.

programme.title: S01 E13
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Rikki has to make up for her mistakes! Convinced that her father’s new girlfriend, Cathy, is dishonest, Rikki sabotages the dinner in which her father tried to ask Cathy for her hand in marriage. To bring the estranged sweethearts back together, Rikki absolutely has to recover the lost engagement ring, which fell into the sea during that tumultuous dinner.

programme.title: S01 E14
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Worrying events agitate the little underwater community of the Bay: clownfish are inexplicably disappearing one after another. The mermaids try to get to the bottom of this mystery, to find their friend Ziggy, a little clownfish who’s among those missing.

programme.title: S01 E15
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Cleo is down in the dumps: she might lose her job at the Oceanic Center, since she said she’s allergic to water, to avoid getting wet in front of Mr. Lambert. Swimming out at sea, she wanders into a strange stone circle – suddenly she wishes she could forget all about this mermaid business. Her wish comes true.

programme.title: S01 E16
programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: It’s Valentines Day! Lewis and Abby spend the day together like sweethearts. Cleo goes crazy with jealousy. She finds out that Lewis has promised to tell Abby a huge secret. And what if – blinded by love – Lewis were to betray Cleo and her friends, by revealing that they are mermaids?! Emma, Cleo and Rikki have to get to the bottom of this

programme.title: S01 E17
programme.sub-title: S01 : E17 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the Bay are overwhelmed: one of the dolphin twins, Robby, has disappeared, captured by an unknown speedboat. Bernie calls on our three mermaids for help: the girls were walking around Dolphin City, which is all decked out for the carnival. But why would anyone kidnap a dolphin?

programme.title: S01 E18
programme.sub-title: S01 : E18 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: In her sleep Cleo creates huge spheres of water that float through the air in Dolphin City, causing chaos. This strange phenomenon is caused by her worries about her Dad, who is on a mission out at sea. And what if Cleo’s worries are real? What if her Dad really has fallen into the hands of dangerous outlaws involved in illegal fishing?

programme.title: S01 E19
programme.sub-title: S01 : E19 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The girls find some turtle eggs on Dolphin City beach: they are too fragile to move, so they take turns watching over them till they hatch. But that's not counting with Miriam and Zane – who are having a beach party!! Meanwhile, underwater, Bernie, cannot bear all the noise and disruption his neighbors are making, and decides to leave his cave and go and stay elsewhere for a bit of a rest.

programme.title: S01 E20
programme.sub-title: S01 : E20 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The White Mermaid is in danger! Her sanctuary, the sunken galleon of Edward the Cruel, is about to be discovered by Stanley Finch, the famous explorer. The girls decide to stop him, and make his boat take another course, towards the sinister underwater stone circle.

programme.title: S01 E21
programme.sub-title: S01 : E21 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: After being carried by a current into the underwater stone circle, Rikki is victim of a terrible spell: she cannot turn back into a human! To break the spell, she has to wait for the full moon – in three days’ time!

programme.title: S01 E22
programme.sub-title: S01 : E22 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The Bay prepares for a great excitement: there's soon to be the first great robotics competition organized by the Dolphin City University. The events will take place underwater, and Lewis wants badly to win first prize: enrolment in the Science Faculty! Unfortunately, Zane is also participating, and true to form, can only do it by cheating.

programme.title: S01 E23
programme.sub-title: S01 : E23 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: Emma’s kid brother Elliott happened to see Rikki’s mermaid tail in the water! He starts telling everyone he’s seen a sea monster. To cover up, the girls and Lewis start building a fake monster, to make people think it was all a hoax. But it’s too late – the whole town’s out looking for the famous “Dolphin City Monster”.

programme.title: S01 E24
programme.sub-title: S01 : E24 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The Vandals are carrying out a nasty plan: they have enlisted a terrible horde of stinging jellyfish to sow terror in the Bay. But the mermaids aren’t able to respond: Rikki grounded, wrongly accused of calling in a fire alarm at school, and Cleo has to help care for swimmers stung by the jellies.

programme.title: S01 E25
programme.sub-title: S01 : E25 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: A lunar eclipse makes Cleo lose her power!! Lewis tries to get it back using scientific methods, but he runs into a lot of trouble! Meanwhile, Teddy the kid turtle has got into trouble with Bernie and the other animals in the Bay after playing too many practical jokes.

programme.title: S01 E26
programme.sub-title: S01 : E26 H2O - Mermaid Adventures, Season 1
programme.desc: The famous explorer Stanley Finch, is back in Dolphin City, with an amazing hi-tech mini-submarine. He’s decided, this time, to find Edward the Cruel’s sunken galleon. Lewis gets enrolled as Stanley’s assistant in the little submarine, and tries to stop him. But he triggers an accident.

programme.title: S01 E01
programme.desc: Country-girl Tara Webster travels to Sydney to audition for the prestigious National Academy of Dance. It’s a tumultuous week as she realises her dream of becoming a dancer is going to be a lot more difficult.

programme.title: S01 E02
programme.desc: Tara arrives at the Academy excited about the year ahead but soon discovers that she is the worst dancer in the class. As Tara struggles to fit in, she learns the hard way to respect her teachers.

programme.title: S01 E03
programme.desc: When Tara’s crush on Ethan threatens to derail her friendship with Kat, Sammy gets her to write a pros and cons list to clear her head. As the roommate war escalates, Abigail wins a decisive victory - emailing Tara’s list to the whole school.

programme.title: S01 E04
programme.desc: The first years are given trust exercises to help forge connections with their pas de deux partners. Tara is frustrated when Christian refuses to participate, however they connect unexpectedly when Tara follows him to the beach.

programme.title: S01 E05
programme.desc: Sammy is forced to choose between dance and his father when compulsory Saturday ballet classes clash with his Synagogue services. Christian struggles to accept the rules of the Academy.

programme.title: S01 E06
programme.desc: The National Ballet comes to town and Tara is thrilled to learn that Kat’s mother is Natasha Willis, the Company’s Principal dancer and her childhood idol. Sammy’s girlfriend, Mia, also arrives forcing Sammy to evaluate his growing feelings.

programme.title: S01 E07
programme.desc: Christian reluctantly agrees to dance in Ethan’s showcase but can’t stand the derivative choreography. In order to show this ballet boy some real hip-hop, Christian takes Ethan home to Maroubra.

programme.title: S01 E17 Under the Weather
programme.sub-title: S01 : E17 H2O : Just add Water, Season 1
programme.desc: A rainy day traps the girls inside. In an effort to "play sick" the girls create a situation where their families become part of a dire medical emergency.

programme.title: S01 E18 Bad Moon Rising
programme.sub-title: S01 : E18 H2O : Just add Water, Season 1
programme.desc: Under the effects of the full moon Rikki goes crazy, boiling dry everything. She runs away to Mako where she meets Zane and kisses him.

programme.title: S01 E19 Hurricane Angela
programme.sub-title: S01 : E19 H2O : Just add Water, Season 1
programme.desc: Cleo and Kim are fighting like crazy and Cleo is pushed to breaking point. Then cousin Angela comes to stay and things just get worse. Cleo realises there are more challenging things than an annoying sister.

programme.title: S01 E20 Hook, Line and Sinker
programme.sub-title: S01 : E20 H2O : Just add Water, Season 1
programme.desc: Emma and Cleo help Lewis catch a huge fish in the fishing competition leading the judges to suspect he’s a cheat. Meanwhile Zane and Rikki are stuck together on a balcony of a fancy hotel where after much argument, they kiss again.

programme.title: S01 E21 Red Herring
programme.sub-title: S01 : E21 H2O : Just add Water, Season 1
programme.desc: Zane thinks Miss Chatham holds the key to the sea monster. Emma needs a change so dyes her hair red. While Zane gets closer to the secret, he also gets closer to Rikki. Zane dives to Miss Chatham’s boat and sees a mermaid!

programme.title: S01 E22 Fish out of Water
programme.sub-title: S01 : E22 H2O : Just add Water, Season 1
programme.desc: Emma and Cleo find out Zane and Rikki are an item and force her to choose - him or them. When Zane appears to side with Harrison over the Mako island development Rikki’s decision is clear. Now it’s Zane’s turn to make a choice.

programme.title: S01 E08
programme.desc: Abigail is devastated that her body seems to be developing and defies Miss Raine by wearing a loose top to class. Sammy is forced to buy a dance belt, with Christian as his unlikely shopping buddy.

programme.title: S01 E09
programme.desc: Mocking her friends’ obsession with teen popstar Myles Kelly, Kat creates a video of herself dancing to one of his songs and then posts it on the internet. She is surprised when the record company invites her to dance in Myles’s next video clip.

programme.title: S01 E10
programme.desc: Christian’s best mate Aaron comes to stay and reveals the truth about the robbery they committed. Later, Aaron uses Christian as an alibi forcing Christian to lie to the police, and to question whether old friends are necessarily good friends.

programme.title: S01 E11
programme.desc: Tara is excited when Ethan asks her to star in his choreography assessment piece, but Ethan only has eyes for his mentor, Dana. Abigail’s sister, Paige, stays for the weekend.

programme.title: S01 E12
programme.desc: Pressure is building at the Academy as the students prepare for exams. Tara tries to ignore her recent “almost-pash” with Ethan in an attempt to stay focused. With her sights set on the first year scholarship, Abigail pushes herself too far.

programme.title: S01 E13
programme.desc: It’s Open Week at the Academy and Tara discovers she is embarrassed by her unsophisticated parents, especially around her new boyfriend Ethan. Her mum later reveals that the farm is in serious financial trouble.

programme.title: S01 E10
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Vashan magically enables his trusted servant Diva to transform into butterfly, to ride inconspicuously on the elephant Anala to the 'old' world, and into a blond babe to spy on the princess there. After witnessing Alex's clumsy magic practice on Kuru, 'Juliet' enrolls at school.

programme.title: S01 E11
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Kuru reports diplomatically to Omar about Alex's slow progress and Devi to Vashan that she's still a magically clumsy brat living a commoner's life, the rival prince allows her to return as butterfly and seduce Kuru as Juliet, so he'll cease being her only good influence.

programme.title: S01 E12
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Kuru accidentally breaks JD's cymbal, but pays for it with a golden coin from Manjipoor worth the eightfold, which he spends on flashy clothes. The Wilsons see Kuru gets rewarded too. When Alex flippantly calls his allowance excessive, he dutifully begs the council to reduce it, which is nearly considered treason for questioning one of its decisions.

programme.title: S01 E13
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: A remark at mother's day from her sanctimonious sister Zoe that Alex is adopted makes her wonder about her magical biological mother, queen Nefari. After Kuru says Omar knew her best, she travels to Manjipoor alone to question him. Vashan spies on them and magically set a trap, entering the queen's magical posthumous vision.

programme.title: S01 E14
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Kuru warns Alex the powerful royal rune to shift time back in order to change things has only been used twelve times for extreme emergencies. Reasoning one wouldn't know if the royal user doesn't tell, the scamp keeps abusing it for petty accidents all day when Marcus finally asks her on a real date.

programme.title: S02 E10 Missed the Boat
programme.sub-title: S02 : E10 H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Cleo is failing at school. Lewis waits for Cleo to ask him for help, giving Charlotte an idea - she volunteers to help tutor Cleo! Cleo is horrified but is forced by Don to accept. Charlotte takes the opportunity to set Cleo mountains of homework; keeping Cleo busy so she can have Lewis all to herself. Charlotte pressures Lewis to take her to Mako Island so she can sketch some landscapes.

programme.title: S02 E11 In Over Our Heads
programme.sub-title: S02 : E11 H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Zane hears of treasure under the ocean and enlists Rikki to help find it, after all a mermaid can search the bottom of the ocean pretty fast. Rikki is reluctant until she discovers her dad is having trouble paying the bills - and they might be forced to move. Rikki gets Emma and Cleo to help, but conceals her true reasons for wanting the treasure.

programme.title: S02 E12 Fish Fever
programme.sub-title: S02 : E12 H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Emma starts acting very weird after pricking her finger on a mysterious barb of coral, suddenly becoming ravenous for things like anchovy flavoured fish food! Cleo’s fish, Hector, exhibits the same behaviour. As Hector begins to look very sick, Emma turns into a mermaid at the marine park, swimming about in front of the glass in the viewing area.

programme.title: S02 E13 Moonwalker
programme.sub-title: S02 : E13 H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Don forces the family to go camping on Mako Island during a Full Moon. Cleo can’t get out of it so invites Emma and Rikki for back-up. Lewis inveigles himself to go too but when he tells Charlotte, she pressures him into taking her as well! The girls are furious with Lewis but he’s in a bind.

programme.title: S02 E14 Get Off My Tail
programme.sub-title: S02 : E14 H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Emma is annoyed to find the one guy she can’t stand suddenly appearing around the juice bar - Ash. When she thinks she’s going to get a promotion at work, Emma is even more annoyed to find that Ash has been given the job ahead of her. As Emma and Ash clash over how the juice bar is run, we discover it’s over a lot more; they’re secretly attracted to each other.

programme.title: S01 E14
programme.desc: Tara returns from the holidays excited to have been awarded the first year scholarship. However, this soon turns to disappointment when Kat leaves her standing alone outside a warehouse party the night before their first ballet class.

programme.title: S01 E15
programme.desc: Petra Hoffman arrives at the Academy on exchange from the Berlin Ballet School. Homesick, she adopts a lost dog and attempts to conceal him in the Boarding House. Kat has been ditching class to spend time with her new boyfriend.

programme.title: S01 E16
programme.desc: Kat is upset when her parent’s ignore her 16th birthday and throws herself a huge party at their harbour front home as revenge. However chaos soon reigns when Tara spies Kat kissing Christian and realizes she can’t ignore her own feelings.

programme.title: S01 E17
programme.desc: It is school camp time and Tara is ostracised by her friends and further humiliated when photos of her and Christian kissing keep appearing everywhere. Tensions culminate in a fight between Kat and Tara.

programme.title: S01 E18
programme.desc: Petra has decided to stay in Australia and enjoy life as an ordinary teenager, however when the Berlin Ballet offers her a contract she has a difficult choice to make.

programme.title: S01 E19
programme.desc: The Institute of Sport’s Australian Rules Forward Squad has been sent to the Academy for some specialised training and the challenge is soon on, between the dancers and the footballers, to prove which is the toughest sport.

programme.title: S01 E20
programme.desc: When the Board decides to cut hip hop and jazz from the curriculum Kat goes on the warpath,blaming her mother for this change. Tara and Christian find themselves together at the beach and their spark is rekindled, so much so that they lose track.

programme.title: S01 E21
programme.desc: It’s a month since Tara’s injury and her plaster is due to come off but Tara seems much more focused on her new boyfriend, Christian, and organising the school formal. Sammy and Abigail decide take their relationship to the next level.

programme.title: S01 E22
programme.desc: Christian’s sentencing hearing has been set and, believing that he’s headed for juvenile detention, Christian decides to stop playing by other people’s rules and goes back to his old neighbourhood.

programme.title: S01 E23
programme.desc: Christian is ready for his court date but everything unravels when old loyalties cause him to change his story. Kat is shocked to learn her brother is moving overseas.

programme.title: S01 E24
programme.desc: Sammy and Christian have made a pact of brotherhood – from now on they are an island of man – but Kat wonders whether Sammy might have a man crush on his new best friend.

programme.title: S01 E25
programme.desc: Rehearsals for The Nutcracker are underway. Tara is playing the role of Clara and quickly discovers that being the star is not all its cracked up to be as Abigail’s claws re-emerge.

programme.title: S01 E26
programme.desc: The end of year performance of the Nutcracker at the Opera House has finally arrived and Tara continues to perform her role so badly that it seems Abigail will be re-cast in her place.

programme.title: S02 E01
programme.desc: Tara reunites with her friends for second year at the Academy and discovers the exciting news that they can compete in a prestigious ballet competition to determine the best young dancer in the world.

programme.title: S02 E02
programme.desc: Tara finds a new hero in Saskia Duncan, the youngest principal dancer in the Company’s history, and a new worry about her future with Christian. Meanwhile Abigail searches for dirt to remove talented Grace from second year.

programme.title: S02 E03
programme.desc: Kat’s struggle to find friends at normal school brightens when she’s able to choreograph a project for drama class, while an exuberant first year, Ben Tickle, is elevated into Second Year and eagerly seeks new friends.

programme.title: S02 E04
programme.desc: Tara’s overjoyed when Company starlet Saskia Duncan is appointed to teach the Academy Second Years; and Ethan rebels against Sebastian’s suppression of his choreography skills.

programme.title: S02 E05
programme.desc: Ethan clashes with Abigail in his attempt to create a spectacular dance performance for Showcase, while Tara finds it hard to compete with Christian’s old friend Kaylah.

programme.title: S02 E06
programme.desc: Sammy’s little brother Ari arrives at the Academy, throwing Sammy’s hectic schedule into havoc and Kat auditions to be a football cheerleader, happily encouraged by Ben. Meanwhile Tara is having self esteem issues when it comes to the looks department.

programme.title: S02 E07
programme.desc: Tara’s concern about the time she spends with Christian impacting her dance study leads to her to suggest they ‘pause’ their relationship, and Ben tries to impress Kat through an ambitious choreography assignment. Meanwhile Grace has cause to be jealous when Abigail and Ethan continue to work closely together.

programme.title: S02 E08
programme.desc: Realising that Saskia’s continuing critique of her dancing could jeopardise her mid-year exams, Tara takes action, while Christian ditches his pas de deux exam to hang out with Kat. Wired on energy drinks, an overtired Sammy kids himself that he’s blitzing exams, and puts Abigail in danger as a result.

programme.title: S02 E09
programme.desc: Exams are over and, with one night of freedom, both the boys and the girls go on a mission to prove they’ll have more fun without each other.

programme.title: S02 E10
programme.desc: Sammy returns home for his Grandpa Morrie’s funeral and to ask his father to support his Academy tuition. While an act of sabotage severs frenemies Tara and Abigail and Kat auditions for the Moulin Rouge.

programme.title: S02 E11
programme.desc: Grace encourages Tara to take action against Saskia’s cruel treatment of her; Kat commences training for the Moulin Rouge and Sammy is assigned a Third Year, Ollie, as a tutor to get him through his exams.

programme.title: S02 E12
programme.desc: Saskia’s bullying of Tara results in a painful injury. Kat convinces Miss Raine to grant her an audition to return to the Academy but has to let Abigail train her.

programme.title: S02 E13
programme.desc: Tara risks serious injury and possible expulsion to compete in the Prix de Fonteyn Preliminary Round, and Kat is on top of the world when she’s allowed back into the Academy.

programme.title: S02 E14
programme.desc: Whilst recovering from her broken back, Tara discovers a hidden side to Ben who is volunteering in a hospital leukaemia ward performance; and Kat tries to settle into First Year.

programme.title: S02 E15
programme.desc: As Tara negotiates her return to the Academy, Ethan’s search for ongoing employment leads him to accept a position choreographing a fringe musical.

programme.title: S02 E16
programme.desc: Sammy and Ollie’s friendship heads into unchartered territory when they go on a road trip so that Sammy can compete in a Prix de Fonteyn regional round, while Christian joins them to reconnect with his estranged father, Raf.

programme.title: S02 E17
programme.desc: The escalating conflict between the First and Second Years results in a showdown to determine which year has the greatest talent, and Tara becomes unhinged when Grace tempts her to get less serious.

programme.title: S01 E24 Love Potion #9
programme.sub-title: S01 : E24 H2O : Just add Water, Season 1
programme.desc: Lewis thinks he’s found a way to control the girl’s mermaidness. The school dance brings all our heroines’ ‘boy issues’ to the surface.

programme.title: S03 E01 The Awakening
programme.sub-title: S03 : E01 H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: Cleo and Rikki face their final year of high school without Emma. They make a new friend in Bella and meet new boy Will.

programme.title: S03 E02 Jungle Hunt
programme.sub-title: S03 : E02 H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: Will seeks confirmation of his first experience on Mako Island. Bella volunteers to misdirect his search so he won’t find the Moon Pool.

programme.title: S03 E03 Keep Your Enemies Close
programme.sub-title: S03 : E03 H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: Cleo seeks a new job as an assistant dolphin trainer at the Marine Park. Rikki fires Nate's band from playing at the cafe until she and Bella reach an understanding.

programme.title: S03 E04 Valentines Day
programme.sub-title: S03 : E04 H2O : Just add Water, Season 3
programme.desc: Cleo's forced to put Lewis' plans for romance on hold to restrain Kim's out of control love life. During this Don meets Samantha, a National Parks Manager and they start to date.

programme.title: S02 E18
programme.desc: During an excursion to the circus, Christian’s dad makes promises he’s unable to keep, Tara tries to repair her friendship with Kat and Sammy goes public about his new romance.

programme.title: S02 E19
programme.desc: Tara hunts for a new crush while the director of a fringe musical tries to convince Abigail to be the star of his show and Grace goes to increasing lengths to get Zach’s attention.

programme.title: S02 E20
programme.desc: Abigail’s best efforts to balance her ballet commitments with the fringe musical splinter when a leaked staff email discounts her chances in the Prix de Fonteyn and her over-supportive mother Anthea unexpectedly arrives at the Academy.

programme.title: S02 E21
programme.desc: The Academy students experience stinging prejudice from the judges during the National Round of the Prix de Fonteyn, just as Sammy’s father visits the competition to watch his son dance for the first time in years.

programme.title: S02 E22
programme.desc: Grace continues to make a play for Zach’s attention, leading her to manufacture a serious accusation; as Christian’s resolve to bounce back from his Prix de Fonteyn elimination drives him toward some reckless behaviour. The winners from the Prix ...

programme.title: S02 E23
programme.desc: Ben tries a variety of tactics in rehearsals for ‘Peter Pan’ to prove to Tara that he’s a leading man, while Kat’s efforts to research her character in the production lead to a realisation about her relationship with Christian.

programme.title: S02 E24
programme.desc: Sammy decides to alter his Prix de Fonteyn solo one day before the start of the International Round, while Tara encounters a new-old nemesis in the girls’ competition.

programme.title: S01 E15
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Kuru tells Alex that Anala's birthday is a grand state affair in Manjipoor, where the elephant chooses one subject to be granted a wish. She offers to his and Omar's delight to preside over the palace party. Told it's invitation only, she magically fakes invitations for her friends and even a few Manjipoor commoner market acquaintances.

programme.title: S01 E16
programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Marcus got the band a gig in his uncle Harry's café, where Zom Records executives have lunch, but the stage is too small, so they must perform a duet by Marcus and Alex, who abuses some minor magic. Omar informs the elders one of Anala's magical headdress jewel was stolen.

programme.title: S01 E17
programme.sub-title: S01 : E17 The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: The band bunch prepares for the school's masked dance, an concept unknown to Kuru. JB was turned down by 48 girls, so he's desperate to ask Kosma on the Manjipoor market and tricks Alex to take him there, supposedly looking for her perfect dress, behind Kuru's back.

programme.title: S01 E18
programme.sub-title: S01 : E18 The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Kuru reports to Omar and the council of elders about Vashan's hostile intrusion in the other world, but they can't counter a royal. Meanwhile Vashan has used the magical gem again, and using a box and carpet can prevent being sent back.

programme.title: S01 E19
programme.sub-title: S01 : E19 The Elephant Princess, Season 1
programme.desc: Marcus and Alex want to exchange one month together-gifts. Alex just asks Kuru's wise advice, but Marcus left the choice to Amanda. Kuru generously gives her one the royal Manjipoor coins she admires. Amanda tricks sweet-tooth Anala into transporting her to Manjipoor to buy a diamond necklace.

programme.title: S02 E15 Irresistible
programme.sub-title: S02 : E15 H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Nate is still trying his best to get Cleo to like him but to no avail. Lewis and Zane find an old myth about mermaids is true - the scent of ambergris sends them wild. Ambergris was once used in perfumes and is deposited by whales, it’s extremely rare but Zane acquires some. Zane’s plan to use it backfires when sleazy Nate gets hold of the scent and quickly has all three mermaid girls on his arm!

programme.title: S02 E16 Double Trouble
programme.sub-title: S02 : E16 H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Lewis has a bad dream about Cleo being discovered as a mermaid. Elliot asks Lewis for advice on girls and Lewis obliges, just to keep him happy. Elliot asks Kim out on a date to the marine park but Kim goes along with it just to take advantage of Elliot paying for everything. When Don forces Cleo to go as chaperone and Elliot begs Lewis to come, Lewis and Cleo find themselves on the date too.

programme.title: S02 E17 Moonstruck
programme.sub-title: S02 : E17 H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Ash keeps trying to ask Emma out but she won’t hear of it - it’s a full moon tonight. Cleo and Rikki goad Ash into being bold with Emma - but they don’t count on him turning up at Emma’s place in time for the full moon! Ash organises a romantic dinner just for him and Emma.

programme.title: S02 E18 The Heat is On
programme.sub-title: S02 : E18 H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: It’s one year since the girls became mermaids and Cleo decides to organise a special party just for them but when Zane and Ash clash at the juice bar, Rikki and Emma take their boyfriend’s side in the argument. Soon Emma and Rikki aren’t talking to each other. No matter what Cleo tries, the friendship is still strained.

programme.title: S02 E19 The Gracie Code Pt 1
programme.sub-title: S02 : E19 H2O : Just add Water, Season 2
programme.desc: Lewis continues to search for clues to the magical effects of the moon pool. He discovers someone called Max Hamilton did research fifty years ago on the strange properties of Mako Island. Lewis tracks the old man down. Max is cagey and plays a cat and mouse game with Lewis. But it becomes clear the old guy knows a lot more about mermaids than Lewis first thought.

programme.title: S02 E25
programme.desc: Fighting shock and numbness after a sudden tragedy, Tara is struggling to find her motivation as a dancer. Meanwhile, Abigail attempts to block her grief by immersing herself in a prestigious audition for a contemporary company tour.

programme.title: S02 E26
programme.desc: Abigail and Tara join forces to go head to head with a formidable enemy and Christian has to choose between being with the girl he loves and his desire to escape.

programme.title: S01 E01
programme.desc: When ZOEY and KIKI, two irrepressible girls from another galaxy land in Lightning Point, their dreams of surfing the waves of Earth’s oceans have finally come true!

programme.title: S01 E02
programme.desc: With their space ship obliterated and no other way of getting home, KIKI and ZOEY settle into the teenage world of Lightning Point at AMBER’s house.

programme.title: S01 E03
programme.desc: To blend in, ZOEY and KIKI start attending AMBER’s school – and find it nothing like school on LUMINA.

programme.title: S01 E04
programme.desc: When KIKI is moved to tears by AMBER’s singing, AMBER makes an important discovery – Luminans can only experience emotions on Earth.

programme.title: S01 E05
programme.desc: Quadrupeds fascinate KIKI and when she finds out that LUCA’s horse BANDIT has been skittish and dangerous to ride ever since they arrived, she feels terrible.

programme.title: S01 E06
programme.desc: LUCA and KIKI have been growing closer and AMBER is sick of being stuck in the middle! Finally, LUCA asks KIKI out on a date – and KIKI can’t wait.

programme.title: S01 E07
programme.desc: When ZOEY escapes the washing up to recharge her energy, AMBER and KIKI think nothing of it – until a big burst of lightning strikes their house. Rushing upstairs, they find ZOEY gone.

programme.title: S01 E08
programme.desc: ZOEY is finding BRANDON a challenging surfing adversary. He’s even started to compliment her on her moves.

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Who doesn't love Sweet Kisses? Join Chef Kimberly Lallouz as she showers them on her multi-course feast all laid out in One Big Recipe. Her Spicy Cornbread gets the first peck with lip-smacking Honey Butter. Then, it's a berry... nice smooch for a seared rare Duck Breast appetizer with Cherries and Walnuts. Avocado Honeydew Gazpacho follows, silky and savoury, with just a gentle sugary buss from the melon, it's a chilled soup gorgeously garnished with crostini and mascarpone. Citrus smooches Salmon on the main course, butter basted and presented with shattered dried citrus shards sprinkled over top and Basmati with Cranberries and Rice Vinegar alongside. Anyone can do it! It's all in the One Big Recipe.

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: What sets this cool One Big Recipe by charismatic chef-host Kimberly Lallouz apart? Folks, may I introduce the 'Wow Factor'? It's that hard- to-define special something, but we know it when we see it! Ogle her Chilled Mussels over Grilled Baguette lightly drizzled with vibrant, golden Saffron Aioli. Gasp at the golden gorgeous Roasted Mini Butternuts, ever so very vivacious with their Salsa Verde, tart Goat Cheese, and nutty toasted sunflower seed garnishes. Bone-in Veal Roast with an easy-to-execute and guaranteed-to-wow presentation is the apex of the event, with grainy mustard vinaigrette-dressed Charred Bok Choy halves. Dessert gets a moment in the spotlight, summer berries draped with applause-inspiring vanilla whipped cream and sweet, crunchy Macadamia Streusel.

Candied sweet potatoes and marshmallows make their perennial appearance here, but Chef Kimberly has a version that will fry"... your brain! programme.desc: When planning a multi-course dinner for six, we all think 'go with the classics' and so does sassy chef-host Kim Lallouz. For her, however, it's Classics... with a Twist! Use the One big Recipe and cook along as Bread and Butter gets a smoke, honey, herb, and black sea salt makeover. Next, Shrimp Cocktail is reinvented with a horseradish kick in her Apricot Ketchup. Then, it's Potato Pave as a standalone course, garnished with tangy tarragon crÃ¨me fraiche and briny salmon roe. Prime Rib is as classic as it comes, but with a sous-vide twist and truffle-spiked Pea and Lardon salad, plan to drop everything so you can twist along! For a sweet ending, dress up dessert from your favourite bakery with a cool trick for making easy lavender ice cream. Dinner is love, and you will love this dinner!

programme.title: MORE One Big Recipe
programme.desc: Re-join Chef Kimberly Lallouz in her One Big Recipe test kitchen as she masterfully creates a week night feast of cheesy polenta and red pepper pesto, creamy paprika shrimp, curried lamb lollipops, salmon ceviche, and Korean kimbap.

programme.title: MORE One Big Recipe
programme.desc: Re-join Chef Kimberly Lallouz in her One Big Recipe test kitchen as she masterfully creates a week night feast of venison tartare, whole roasted maitake mushroom with a trio of sauces, seared scallops with a pea and fava bean puree and pepper relish, and a dandelion salad.

programme.title: Spencer's Big 30
programme.desc: In 30 minutes, chef Spencer Watts cooks up homey classics including a mouth-watering Chicken Stew and melt-in-your-mouth Herb Butter Biscuits.

programme.title: Spencer's Big 30
programme.desc: Chef Spencer Watts cooks up an Italian feast for four including a cheesy Cannelloni and a fast and fluffy Tiramisu.

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Who doesn't love Sweet Kisses? Join Chef Kimberly Lallouz as she showers them on her multi-course feast all laid out in One Big Recipe. Her Spicy Cornbread gets the first peck with lip-smacking Honey Butter. Then, it's a berry... nice smooch for a seared rare Duck Breast appetizer with Cherries and Walnuts. Avocado Honeydew Gazpacho follows, silky and savoury, with just a gentle sugary buss from the melon, it's a chilled soup gorgeously garnished with crostini and mascarpone. Citrus smooches Salmon on the main course, butter basted and presented with shattered dried citrus shards sprinkled over top and Basmati with Cranberries and Rice Vinegar alongside. Anyone can do it! It's all in the One Big Recipe.

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: What sets this cool One Big Recipe by charismatic chef-host Kimberly Lallouz apart? Folks, may I introduce the 'Wow Factor'? It's that hard- to-define special something, but we know it when we see it! Ogle her Chilled Mussels over Grilled Baguette lightly drizzled with vibrant, golden Saffron Aioli. Gasp at the golden gorgeous Roasted Mini Butternuts, ever so very vivacious with their Salsa Verde, tart Goat Cheese, and nutty toasted sunflower seed garnishes. Bone-in Veal Roast with an easy-to-execute and guaranteed-to-wow presentation is the apex of the event, with grainy mustard vinaigrette-dressed Charred Bok Choy halves. Dessert gets a moment in the spotlight, summer berries draped with applause-inspiring vanilla whipped cream and sweet, crunchy Macadamia Streusel.

programme.title: Pardon The Indigestion
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 Lobster Curry and More!
programme.desc: Enjoy a selection of recipes and food clips from Gusto TV, including Lobster Curry and more! Discover flavourful dishes, creative recipes, helpful cooking tips and plenty of inspiration for your next meal, with something delicious for every occasion.

programme.title: Pardon The Indigestion
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Jerk Lobster Tails with Grilled Pineapple Salsa and More!
programme.desc: Enjoy a selection of recipes and food clips from Gusto TV, including Jerk Lobster Tails with Grilled Pineapple Salsa and more! Discover flavourful dishes, creative recipes, helpful cooking tips and plenty of inspiration for your next meal, with something delicious for every occasion.

programme.title: Spencer's Holiday BBQ
programme.desc: Join charismatic chef Spencer Watts at his glorious rooftop patio for a one-hour special featuring a full holiday spread, all made on the BBQ. Spencer’s festive menu is all about creative BBQ twists with his delectable, mouth-watering recipes including Burnt Orange Cranberry Marmalade, Maple Rye Pumpkin Pie, and Asparagus with Smoked Salmon Dip. Save room for the piece de Q-sistance: Smoked Turkey Two Ways. This year, take your holiday feast outside and serve up something deliciously different.

programme.title: Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Get your 'Gobble Gobble' on with this special episode of Holiday Eatz, featuring fun and charming host Kimberly Lallouz! She starts her terrific Turkey Day menu with a harvest happy Kale Salad heaped with beets, candied pecans, toasted lentils, and goat cheese. Thanksgiving dinner needs Hot Rolls, Chef Lallouz packs hers with cranberries and corn, then serves them as a standalone course with a cheesy, creamy Mushroom Fondue! Next, it's time to talk turkey with a trick that cuts your poultry cooking time in half! Her Spatchcock Turkey is not just faster than old school, it's yummier too, with a garlic-herb marinade and a unique side of mixed beans and rice! Candied sweet potatoes and marshmallows make their perennial appearance here, but Chef Kimberly has a version that will fry"... your brain! Check out her Sweet Potato Churros with Marshmallow Creme for a presentation you"... do-nut"... want to miss!

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: In preparation for a relaxing holiday with friends and family, FLOUR POWER THANKSGIVING: PIES GALORE invites you into the kitchen to bring a twist to your Thanksgiving classics. In this holiday special, host Jessica McGovern takes us through three new and exciting treats to bring to your table, sharing some of her favourite tips and tricks along the way. Jessica offers up three alternatives to a standard Thanksgiving dessert - serving up light and flaky Pie Fries with Apple Caramel Dip, a rich and creamy Sweet Potato Pie, and a luscious Vanilla Bourbon Sweet Potato Pie Cake coated in a fluffy marshmallow frosting. These quick and easy recipes will put you in the holiday spirit while adding a new taste to classic desserts.

programme.title: BLITZ'N
programme.desc: Get ready for a special holiday BLITZ! with master mixologist Yvonne Langen as she prepares her favorite holiday cocktails and party snacks in the Gusto TV kitchen!

programme.title: The Wizard of Whatever: Holiday Edition
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The Wizard of Whatever: Holiday Edition
programme.desc: Gusto TV’s Wizard of Whatever, Chef Kyle Crawford, is dishing up a holiday feast! There’ll be food, fun, elves… and even jolly old St. Nick himself may make an appearance! Join in as Kyle cooks up a Christmas goose complete with stuffing and gravy, plus all the sides and salads, and even a flashy flambé dessert! Merry whatever!

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Twists on the Classics
programme.desc: Christmas is right around the corner and it calls for a little fun - like a twist on traditional holiday desserts! FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: TWISTS ON THE CLASSICS offers a new take on some of your favourites to bring you a fresh perspective and world of flavour for the holidays! Enchanting host Jessica McGovern plays off classic desserts, serving up handy hints on how to get the most out of every bite. From sweet and fluffy Gumdrop Cakes drizzled with a light lemony glaze to a delectable Eggnog Ski Slope Cake decorated with rosemary trees and a few friends to hit the hills, Jessica's unique holiday recipes will surly make it on your list of Christmas traditions!

programme.title: One World Kitchen: Our Favourite Holiday Recipes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 One World Kitchen: Our Favourite Holiday Recipes
programme.desc: In this special holiday episode of One World Kitchen, Hana (Japan), Vanessa (Italy), Natalia (Argentina), and Pailin (Thailand) get together to cook their favorite traditional holiday dishes influenced by their respective cultures. Christmas Sushi Rolls, Veal in a Creamy Tuna Sauce with Capers, Striped Bass in Garlic and Lime Marinade, and an epic Timballo. For the final recipe, our hosts combine all the flavors of One World Kitchen into a truly internationally-inspired turkey dish.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italian Christmas
programme.desc: BONACINI'S ITALIAN CHRISTMAS is a heartwarming one-hour holiday special featuring celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini as he shares some of his favourite Italian Christmas Eve dishes. Michael invites us to the set of his series "Bonacini's Italy" to cook up traditional Italian fare like Salt Cod Mousse on Polenta Crostini and Pork Braised in Milk. Michael takes us on a holiday culinary journey as he explores homey Christmas flavours and traditions, offering tips for perfecting dishes from the regions of Veneto, Sardinia, Calabria, Sicily, and Emilia Romagna.

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: The holidays are here! And the holidays come with a lineup of treats you won't be able to resist! From sweet and salty to traditional and unconventional, FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: BIG WOW DESSERTS covers it all. To get in the holiday spirit, enchanting host Jessica McGovern introduces two desserts that could impress any Scrooge. First, Jessica bakes a decadent Chocolate Yule Log stuffed with a creamy Salted Caramel Frosting and finishes with a holiday-inspired cake decorated with homemade peppermint candy canes! Interwoven with tricks of the trade, Jessica guides us through her simple yet inspiring treats that are perfect for a big Christmas celebration.

programme.title: Einzeltest Volvo S60 T5
programme.desc: Was kann der Volvo S60 mit 2-Liter-Vierzylinder? Alexander Bloch nimmt die Mittelklasse-Limousine mit 250 PS starkem T5-Motor unter die Lupe, bevor dieser durch einen Mild-Hybrid ersetzt wird.

programme.title: Einzeltest VW Golf GTI TCR
programme.desc: Der VW Golf GTI TCR tritt zum Test an. Als Sondermodell TCR will der GTI auch dem Segment der Hot Hatches seinen Stempel aufdrücken. Schafft das der Kompakte? Und inwiefern meistert er den Balance-Akt zwischen Rennstrecke und Alltagstauglichkeit? Jochen Albig gibt die Antworten ? bei Die Tester.

programme.title: Einzeltest Renault Mégane R.S. Trophy
programme.desc: Aus Frankreich reist der Renault Mégane RS Trophy zum Test an. Das Trophy-Modell will der Baureihe des Mégane RS die dynamische Krone aufsetzen. Inwiefern ihm das gelingt, welche Extras geboten werden und ob der Hot Hatch auch Alltag kann, beantwortet Jochen Albig ? bei Die Tester.

programme.title: Einzeltest Porsche Macan S
programme.desc: Ein altes Eisen? Porsche schickt den überarbeiten Macan S zum Einzeltest. Interessantes Detail: Das SUV basiert nicht auf dem aktuellen Audi Q5, sondern auf dessen Vorgänger. Alexander Bloch findet heraus, wie frisch der Macan noch ist.

programme.title: Einzeltest Hyundai Kona Elektro
programme.desc: Es gibt viele Wege in die E-Mobilität: Hyundai elektrifiziert das SUV Kona. Zum Test kommt die vollelektrische Version mit 150 Kilowatt und Frontantrieb. Alexander Bloch findet heraus, wie sich der Elektro-Kona vom herkömmlichen Modell unterscheidet.

programme.title: Einzeltest Tesla Model 3
programme.desc: Das Tesla Model 3 Performance fährt zum Test. Der US-amerikanische Autobauer hat das Ziel, besonders dynamische Elektroautos herzustellen. Alexander Bloch findet heraus, ob das stimmt und welche Stärken sowie Schwächen im Model 3 stecken.

programme.title: Einzeltest BMW 330i
programme.desc: Der BMW 330i im Test: Kann der Vier-Zylinder mit 258 PS in Sachen Dynamik überzeugen oder büßt der 3er an Sportlichkeit ein? Alexander Bloch nimmt den Bayer genauer unter die Lupe.

programme.title: Einzeltest Skoda Kodiaq RS
programme.desc: Der Skoda Kodiaq RS markiert die Spitze der Kodiaq-Familie. 240 Diesel-PS werden mit dem Nutzwert eines SUV kombiniert. Ob auch RS drin steckt, wo RS draufsteht, testet Alexander Bloch.

programme.title: Einzeltest BMW M2 Competition
programme.desc: BMW hat mit der Abkehr vom Hinterradantrieb und dem Sechszylinder-Motor bei seinen neuen Kompakt-Modellen viele Fans aufgewühlt. Den BMW M2 Competition betrifft das nicht. Im Gegenteil: Mit dem echten Reihensechszylinder-Biturbo aus seinem großen Bruder M4 ausgestattet, soll das kleine Coupé für maximalen Fahrspaß sorgen. Und so lässt Alexander Bloch im Test die Hinterreifen qualmen.

programme.title: Einzeltest Porsche 718 Cayman GTS
programme.desc: Der Boxer-Motor ist geblieben, allerdings hat er zwei Zylinder verloren: Der Porsche 718 Cayman GTS rollt mit einem Vierzylinder-Turbo zum Test. Entgegen sonstiger Gepflogenheiten setzen die Zuffenhausener beim kleinen Sportler auf ein Mittelmotor-Konzept. Kann der 365 PS starke GTS mit gutem Handling über den Verlust des Sechszylinder-Boxers hinwegtrösten? Alexander Bloch findet es im Test heraus.

programme.title: Einzeltest Honda CR-V Hybrid
programme.desc: Honda verpasst seinem SUV CR-V einen Hybrid-Antrieb. Wie sich der große Japaner damit auf der Straße und auf dem Versuchsgelände schlägt? Bei Die Tester finden Sie es heraus. Reporter Jochen Albig checkt den Honda und gibt die Antworten.

programme.title: Einzeltest Audi A3 Limosine
programme.desc: Stufenheck-Pionier: Seit 2013 ist Audi mit der A3 Limousine in der Kompaktklasse unterwegs. Wie gut ist die erste Generation heute noch? Jochen Albig, Leiter auto motor und sport-Testabteilung, fährt den A3 mit 190-PS-Turbobenziner und Allradantrieb.

programme.title: Einzeltest Toyota RAV4 Hybrid
programme.desc: Toyota spendiert auch seinem SUV RAV4 einen Hybrid-Antriebsstrang. Was für ein Auto resultiert daraus - ein Dynamiker, ein relaxter Reise- und Familienwagen oder ein großer Pfennigfuchser? Bei Die Tester gibt Reporter Jochen Albig die Antworten.

programme.title: Einzeltest Mercedes CLA
programme.desc: Eine Mini-Luxusklasse? Der Mercedes-Benz CLA erinnert optisch innen und außen an den Oberklassegleiter CLS. Jochen Albig testet was im kompakten viertürigen Coupé namens CLA steckt und wie sich Generation zwei weiterentwickelt hat.

programme.title: Petrolheads - Porsche 911 e-Fuels - Unikat mit 1.200 Autogrammen
programme.desc: Rallye-Legende Walter Röhrl nimmt an der gleichnamigen Röhrl Klassik im Sauerland mit einem Porsche 911 teil und setzt dabei ein zukunftsweisendes Zeichen: Der Sportwagen wird mit klimaneutralen E-Fuels betrieben. Der synthetische Kraftstoff bietet Oldtimer-Enthusiasten die Möglichkeit, auch in Zukunft ihre historischen Fahrzeuge umweltfreundlich zu bewegen. Was genau dahinter steckt, erklärt Walter Röhrl im Video.

programme.title: Petrolheads - Porsche 914/6 GT: mehr Leistung als üblich
programme.desc: Dieser Porsche 914 gehört zur Sammlung von Thomas Groschek. Der Sportwagen wurde mehrfach überarbeitet und besitzt nun einen 3-Liter-Motor, der rund 240 PS leistet.

programme.title: Petrolheads - Porsche 911 2.7 Targa: Jugendtraum aus Italien
programme.desc: Mit diesem Porsche 911 Targa ging für den Besitzer ein Jugendtraum in Erfüllung. Welche Geschiche hinter dem roten Elfer steckt, das erfahrt Ihr in diesem Video von der "3. Röhrl-Klassik".

programme.title: Petrolheads - Sportwagen mit royalem Vorbesitz: Ferrari 275 GTS
programme.desc: Christopher Stahl präsentiert seinen Ferrari mit einzigartiger Vorgeschichte: Der 275 GTS wurde in den 60er-Jahren an ein Königshaus ausgeliefert und befindet sich heute in perfekt restauriertem Zustand.

programme.title: Petrolheads - Warum trägt der elegante Sportler kein Rot? Ferrari 250 GT SWB
programme.desc: Dieser Ferrari 250 GT trägt den Zusatz "SWB" für "Short Wheelbase". Das bedeutet, dass der Italiener einen kürzeren Radstand besitzt als andere 250er-Modelle. Dieses Exemplar hat zudem eine lange Historie und wurde oft auf der Rennstrecke bewegt.

programme.title: Petrolheads - Alfa Romeo 33 Stradale: Gegenwart trifft Vergangenheit
programme.desc: Bei "Pista & Piloti" lebt italienische Historie: Das große Rennstrecken-Event lockt zahlreiche Fans der Marke Alfa Romeo und ihre Fahrzeuge an. Darunter eine besondere Replika, die ihren modernen Nachfahren trifft: Der Alfa Romeo 33 Stradale von Michael Stoschek ist ein liebevoller Nachbau des legendären Supersportlers, der 2023 eine Neuauflage erhielt.

programme.title: Petrolheads - Alfa Romeo tz1 - Edler Exot auf dem Racetrack
programme.desc: Es ist eins der Traumprojekt der Familie Gasteiger. Ein echter Alfa Romeo tz1. Ein Auto, das beim 24h-Stunden Rennen in Le Mans bewegt worden ist, darf jetzt wieder auf die Strecke. Bei der „pista e piloti“ auf dem Trevi-Testcenter im Hunsrück bringt er Rennsportnostalgie in Reinkultur. Wie es ist so einen Wagen zu bewegen und der Oldie so besonders ist, dass erfahrt ihr hier!

programme.title: Petrolheads - Alfa Romeo Giulietta TI: Über 60 Jahre alt, aber noch fit für die Rennstrecke?
programme.desc: Alfonso Vitelli liebt die Marke Alfa Romeo und seine Giulietta, die für den Rennstreckeneinsatz gedacht ist. Mit der über 60 Jahre alten Italienerin ist er beim Event "Pista & Piloti" genau richtig.

programme.title: Petrolheads - Porsche 911 e-Fuels - Unikat mit 1.200 Autogrammen
programme.desc: Rallye-Legende Walter Röhrl nimmt an der gleichnamigen Röhrl Klassik im Sauerland mit einem Porsche 911 teil und setzt dabei ein zukunftsweisendes Zeichen: Der Sportwagen wird mit klimaneutralen E-Fuels betrieben. Der synthetische Kraftstoff bietet Oldtimer-Enthusiasten die Möglichkeit, auch in Zukunft ihre historischen Fahrzeuge umweltfreundlich zu bewegen. Was genau dahinter steckt, erklärt Walter Röhrl im Video.

programme.title: Garagengold Kurz - Alfa Romeo Giulietta Sprint Speciale - Die Königin aller Alfa?
programme.desc: Ist die extrem seltene Alfa Romeo Giulietta Sprint Speciale die Königin aller Alfa? Ihr besonders aerodynamisches Kleid gefällt ganz besonders, nur was hat es mit der Plexiglas-Scheibe vor der Windschutzscheibe auf sich? Alfa-Fan Thomas Borst nimmt uns mit auf eine sommerliche Ausfahrt, erklärt Historie, Technik und Fahrgefühl. Einen Zwischenhalt gibt es beim Deutschen Automuseum in Langeburg, wo es ebenso einiges zu sehen gibt.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Renault Scenic E-Tech: Überzeugend, aber da wäre noch mehr drin gewesen!
programme.desc: Der Renault Scenic hat sich vom Verbrenner-Van zum Elektro-SUV gewandelt. Pluspunkte gibt‘s für den modernen Innenraum, das großzügige Platzangebot und das auf Komfort ausgelegte Fahrwerk. Wie der Familien-Stromer auf ganzer Linie abschneidet, seht ihr jetzt im E-Auto-Supertest mit Alex Bloch.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Honda e:Ny1 im E-Auto-Supertest
programme.desc: Nach hübsch und unpraktisch, jetzt normal und praktisch? Der Honda e war der erste Versuch der Japaner mit einem vollelektrischen Fahrzeug. Der Neue mit dem unaussprechlichen Namen e:Ny1 basiert auf der von Honda neu entwickelten Frontantriebsplattform e:N Architecture F, die weltweit in Elektrofahrzeugen im B-Segment zum Einsatz kommen wird. Wie schlägt sich das kompakte SUV im E-Auto Supertest?

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Kia EV9 im E-Auto-Supertest
programme.desc: Der Kia EV9 ist der „King Kong“ unter den SUVs – ein imposanter Koloss, den manche als überdimensioniert und unnötig empfinden. Alexander Bloch räumt mit diesen Vorurteilen auf und stellt den EV9 im direkten Vergleich zum beliebten VW ID.Buzz unter Beweis.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Tesla Model 3 LR
programme.desc: Das Tesla Model 3 Long Range des Jahrgangs 2021 tritt zum Elektroauto-Supertest an. Was hat sich bei der Modellpflege getan? Wie hoch ist der Verbrauch? Wie gut die Reichweite? Kann der Tesla bei Komfort, Bedienung und Verarbeitungsqualität überzeugen? Alexander Bloch testet das Model 3 in 10 Kategorien und vergibt pro Kapitel maximal 6 Sterne. Ist Tesla wirklich die Benchmark im E-Auto-Bereich?

programme.title: Vorfahrt - BYD Seal
programme.desc: BYD treibt seine Expansionsstrategie voran und bringt dafür ein neues Modell nach Europa: den BYD Seal. Die sportliche Elektrolimousine soll mit Performance überzeugen. Gelingt das? Unser Redakteur Tim Hohenschurz verschafft sich einen ersten Eindruck.

programme.title: Vorfahrt - IAA 2023 Mini Electric
programme.desc: Mini zeigt auf der IAA zwei neue Modelle: den Cooper und den Countryman. Beide kommen zuerst rein elektrisch. Es wird aber auch noch Verbrennermodelle geben. Besonders im Innenraum setzen die Briten jetzt auf Minimalismus und Digitalisierung.

programme.title: Neuvorstellung - BMW iX3 vs. Mercedes-Benz GLC
programme.desc: Premiere für zwei neue Premium-Elektro-SUVs auf der IAA Mobility: der BMW iX3 50 xDrive und der Mercedes-Benz GLC 400 EQ. In dieser Folge von 10 von 10 vergleichen wir beide Modelle in 10 Fakten von Reichweite über Leistung bis Preis. Welches E-SUV bietet mehr Alltagstauglichkeit, Technik und Fahrspaß?

programme.title: Neuvorstellung - Oldtimer mit Blaulicht: Einsatzfahrzeuge im Ruhestand
programme.desc: Beim Bikertreff in Krefeld treffen sich nicht nur Motorradfans, sondern auch echte Legenden auf vier Rädern, alte Einsatzfahrzeuge mit Geschichte. Ob Polizei-Streifenwagen, historische Krankenwagen, THW Fahrzeuge oder Feuerwehrklassiker. Hier kommen alle zusammen, die früher im Einsatz unterwegs waren. Im Interview stellen wir zwei besondere Feuerwehr Oldtimer vor und zeigen, warum diese Fahrzeuge bis heute eine ganz besondere Ausstrahlung haben.

programme.title: Neuvorstellung - Oldtimer mit Blaulicht

programme.title: Dacia Sandero (2021): Wie baut man den günstigsten Neuwagen Deutschlands?
programme.desc: Beim Thema Dacia scheiden sich die Geister: Für manche ist er der Vernunft-Kauf schlechthin. Andere würde sich lieber einen jungen Gebrauchtwagen einer anderen Marke zum gleichen Preis holen. Mit der neuesten Sandero-Generation will Dacia ab 2021 noch mehr Kunden für sich begeistern. Alexander Bloch erklärt wie Dacia so günstig produzieren kann. Was bekommt man vom Discounter unter den Autoherstellern? Im Fahrbericht: Dacia Sandero Stepway 2021.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt E-Auto-Highlights 2021: Die 10 wichtigsten Neuheiten
programme.desc: Mit dem neuen ID.4 will VW bei den Elektro-SUV durchstarten. Doch kann der Wolfsburger auch gegen den kalifornischen E-Auto-Platzhirsch Tesla ankommen. Alexander Bloch fährt den neuen Volkswagen ID.4 und vergleicht ihn gegen das Tesla Model Y. Wie schneidet das SUV bei Rechweite, Verbrauch und Fahrdynamik ab? Was bietet der ID.4 bei Raumangebot, Verarbeitung und bei der Ladegeschwindigkeit? Und ganz wichtig: Hat VW die Software-Probleme endlich im Griff? Die Antworten gibt es im Test.

programme.title: DANCE: Take the Title - S1 E3

programme.title: The Clip Show

programme.title: Inside Pro Surfing - Margaret River Pro 2026

programme.title: Inside Pro Surfing - Rip Curl Pro Bells Beach 2026

programme.title: BIKE: Emerald Storm

programme.title: AvD Drift Championship - S2 E5

programme.title: UCI MTB World Cup 2025: Les Gets – Highlights

programme.title: Hard Enduro: Red Bull Romaniacs 2025 – Highlights
programme.desc: Vier Tage, kaum Erholung und kein leichter Meter: Bei den Red Bull Romaniacs 2025 kämpfen sich die Hard-Enduro-Asse durch Rumäniens Berge – gegen Gegner, Erschöpfung und gnadenloses Gelände.

programme.title: BIKE: Red Bull Hardline - Best of 2025

programme.title: UCI MTB World Cup 2025 Lenzerheide - Highlights

programme.title: BIKE: Red Bull Valparaíso Cerro Abajo 2026 – Highlights

programme.title: BIKE: Red Bull Cerro Abajo - Doku

programme.title: Red Bull Seifenkistenrennen: Geniale Designs - E5

programme.title: SURF: Against Gravity

programme.title: KITESURF: Red Bull King of the Air 2025 - Highlights

programme.title: More than a Dive - S4 E2

programme.title: SURF: Inside Pro Surfing – S2 E9

programme.title: CLIMB: Reel Rock - S11 E6

programme.title: SURF: Inside Pro Surfing – S2 E7

programme.title: SailGP: Perth 2026 – Highlights

programme.title: WORLD OF FREESPORTS 2017
programme.sub-title: S01 : E38 Winter Games 2017 - Freeride Ski & Snowboard - New Zealand
programme.desc: Atemberaubende Landschaften, die weltbesten Talente und die Gastfreundschaft der Kiwis werden einem weltweiten Publikum präsentiert, wenn die Winter Games New Zealand ihre bisher vielfältigste Veranstaltung bekannt geben. Die Stars der Olympischen Winterspiele, der Paralympics und der X-Games machen sich erneut auf den Weg in die neuseeländischen Südalpen, um die ersten großen Wintersportmeisterschaften der Saison auszutragen. Sie kämpfen in verschiedenen Sportarten wie Freestyle-Skiing, Snowboarding, Ski Alpin, Skilanglauf und Curling um Ruhm und Ehre. Die 5. alle zwei Jahre stattfindenden Winterspiele in Neuseeland werden in der Region der Südlichen Seen ausgetragen.

programme.title: WORLD OF FREESPORTS 2022
programme.desc: In Frankreich gibt es zahlreiche geologische und aquatische Wunder zu entdecken, darunter die Schluchten der Ardèche. Im Herbst sind der Fluss und seine Schluchten die perfekte Kulisse für einen Wettbewerb im Wildwasserpaddeln.

programme.title: WORLD OF FREESPORTS 2024

programme.title: WORLD OF FREESPORTS 2021

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Die Strongman Champions League 2025 startet in Joensuu, Finnland, bei eisigen -5 C. Die Athleten beginnen den Wettkampf mit einem Frame Carry auf Eis und Schnee. Teilnehmer aus den USA, Finnland, der Trkei und weiteren Lndern kmpfen mit der Klte und ihren Debts, whrend die extremen Bedingungen den Saisonauftakt prgen.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025

Lokalmatador Aivars maukstelis kehrt zu seinem emotionalen letzten Auftritt in Lettland zurck und strebt seinen dritten SCL-Titel an. Der Wettbewerb startet mit einem Truck Pull, der frh erste Richtzeiten setzt.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025

programme.title: Angebissen von Null auf Fisch - Barsch oder Karpfen

programme.title: Amur auf die heiße Tour - Ein Kraftpaket aus der Donauau

Also featured on the card, Tariq Osaro will face Abderrahman Barkouch in a heavyweight battle, and Nordin Ben Moh meets Kyle Todd in a lightweight fight.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: In the main event, former GLORY Featherweight Title Challenger Abraham Vidales will face Tomás Aguirre, a native of Argentina who has finished 22 of his 26 wins. In the co-main event, top-10 GLORY middleweight contender Ivan Galaz will meet Renan Altamiro. Also featured on the card, GLORY debutants Jonas Julio and Javier Aparicio will square off in a welterweight clash, and top-five GLORY featherweight contender Denis Wosik will go for his third consecutive victory as he takes on Marcos Rios. Additionally, top-ten GLORY lightweight contender Bruno Gazani will fight Nick Chasteen, and Tessa de Kom will replace Sarah Moussaddak (injury) and meet Giuliana Cosnard in a Super Bantamweight bout to open the card.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY double champ Chico Kwasi (46-6-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world championship in the main event in a trilogy fight against top Bulgarian Teodor Hristov (20-5, 8 KO). A gigantic heavyweight clash takes place as former interim heavyweight champion Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (31-5-1, 17 KO) collides with the legend Errol ‘The Bonecrusher’ Zimmerman (112-21-1, 45 KO). Also happening at GLORY 109 are the Welterweight Proving Grounds. Several match-ups will take place where fighters aim to impress in order to put their names forward for the GLORY welterweight eight-man grand prix at the end of the year.
